item.title: Thompson Thrift Opens Landing at Lemay in Fort Collins
item.summary: Thompson Thrift has marked the opening of The Landing at Lemay, a 344-unit multifamily community in Fort Collins, Colorado, with a ribbon-cutting event. The property has reached nearly 60% occupancy since welcoming its first residents in December.
